q: The smooth min-entropy H_min^ε(X|Y) in one-shot information theory represents:
opts: The minimum number of bits extractable about X given Y with failure probability ≤ ε
The maximum entropy over all distributions ε-close to P_{XY}
The von Neumann entropy of the quantum state
exp: Smooth min-entropy H_min^ε(X|Y) characterizes one-shot privacy amplification: it is the maximum number of (nearly) uniform secret bits extractable given adversary's information Y, with failure ε. As n → ∞, it converges to the conditional entropy rate.
